Use an integer from 1 to 5: 1 = highly predictive (minimal penalty), 2 = moderately predictive, 3 = uncertain/weak, 4 = unlikely useful, 5 = irrelevant (maximum penalty). Return strict JSON with the single top-level key "penalties" mapping every supplied field ID to its integer penalty in {1,2,3,4,5}.
